numerator.rule: For target age A in reference year Y, union unique persons vaccinated at ages 11..A in the corresponding cohort years Y-(A-age).

denominator.source: IBGE Censo Demográfico 2022 - população por idade simples
denominator.official_method_note: MS NT 50/2026 uses Censo 2022 by simple age for all cohort years until newer suitable denominators are available.

limitations: Deaths are not excluded exactly from historical vaccinated cohorts.
Coverage remains unavailable when the normalized Censo denominator is missing.
Age/year inconsistencies in nominal records are flagged as possible cross-cohort overlap.
